# Taleem360 - School Cloud ERP & LMS Suite Pakistan

> Taleem360 is a unified cloud database suite automating K-12 attendance tracking, automated student fee collection networks, double-entry ledgers, and parent messaging portals for schools across Pakistan, the Middle East, South Asia, and Africa. Every subscription funds free curriculum notes for a child in need.
